title: Double-tap Delete on a todo — no confirm, no undo, no isPending guard

steps: 1. On /today, tap + in Today's Actions, type 'OVN-today-r1-01 delete test', tap Add. 2. Locate its row and fire two near-simultaneous clicks on the X button (TodayActions.jsx:187-193) before the first request's response returns (two click() calls, no await between them).
expected: Exactly one todo is removed, no crash, no error surfaced. Per judge rules, a destructive action with zero confirm and zero undo is itself worth flagging (contrast Mind's Reading/Study/Skills tabs, which all gate delete behind ConfirmDialog).
risk: src/components/dashboard/TodayActions.jsx:92-98 deleteMutation has no confirm dialog, no undo/toast-with-undo, and the X button (:187-193) has no disabled={deleteMutation.isPending} guard.

title: Two AI-seeded todos share identical text but different domains — one silently disappears
setup: Test athlete, tagged rows (OVN-today-r1-03). Simulate via testDb(): insert two todos rows for today, same text 'OVN-today-r1-03 duplicate text', different domain values ('training' and 'nutrition'), both source='ai_generated', different created_at (1 minute apart).
steps: 1. Insert both tagged rows directly via testDb(). 2. Reload /today. 3. Count how many rows render in Today's Actions matching that text. 4. Toggle the visible one complete, then check via testDb() which underlying row(s) got the update.
expected: Ideally both distinct todos are visible and independently actionable. Actual/known behavior per code: the client-side de-dupe-by-text filter (TodayActions.jsx:47-52) keeps only the earliest created_at, so the second (later) row is invisible in the UI even though it still exists in the DB and could resurface unexpectedly after the visible one is deleted.
risk: src/components/dashboard/TodayActions.jsx:47-52 seen/dedupe Set keys purely on t.text, ignoring id/domain — a legitimate second todo with matching text is permanently hidden while it exists.
serializeReason: writes tagged todos rows for today; other attackers reading today's todo list/count in this window would see the collapsed view.

title: Delete the visible (earlier) duplicate — does the hidden later duplicate resurface?
setup: Continuation of today-r1-03's state (two same-text tagged rows still present) OR fresh setup: insert two todos with identical text via testDb(), tagged OVN-today-r1-04, 2 minutes apart.
steps: 1. Ensure two same-text tagged rows exist (earlier one is what's currently visible per the de-dupe). 2. On /today, tap the visible row's X to delete it. 3. Reload /today. 4. Check whether the second (previously hidden) duplicate now appears.
expected: After deleting what looked like 'the' todo, the athlete sees it's gone. If the hidden duplicate now surfaces, that's a confusing 'deleted item came back' experience worth flagging as a no-real-undo-but-also-no-real-delete UX bug.
risk: src/components/dashboard/TodayActions.jsx:47-52 — de-dupe recomputes 'earliest' each render, so deleting the previously-earliest visible row can promote a previously-hidden duplicate into view on the next load.
